scope: Writer admission and explicit retirement under stable-gate, lock-handoff coherence, completed-or-cancelled prior I/O, and named primitive contracts. Actual gate/fence checks, marker persistence and enumerated drain are checked Rust; public Store wiring, native path/header binding and standard OS calls retain their separately reviewed language/native boundaries.
established: Successful writer acquisition holds the expected gate, checks its complete header and rejects observed fencing. Native Store mutation entry points keep the private Permit alive.

Retirement refuses a paused holder. Successful gate handoff requires earlier submitted I/O completed or cancelled; actual retirement fences and drains before reconcile/seal/receipt, and errors stop later phases.

Actual registry decoding/business history, exact result provenance, two-pass reconciliation, owner coverage, seal selection and authenticated graph traversal are also checked. Complete shared Journal/catalog/publication composition remains separate.

evidence_levels.finite_model: WriterRetirement recover/abandon positive configurations and five safety-negative configurations. Finite exploration does not prove filesystem internals.

environment: No gate inode replacement/ABA; durable fence observations are fresh/coherent after lock handoff.
OS locking excludes live holders; remote submitted I/O finishes or is cancelled before successful handoff. Advisory locks, PID, timeout and process death alone do not prove remote drain.
Complete directory observation of the private writer scope, individual open/read/unlink/fsync, path/header mapping and library contracts.
Individual authenticated Reader/digest and shared Journal/catalog operations retain their named correspondence obligations.
remaining: Complete publication/open-reservation-to-catalog/GC composition, initial native scope construction and shared Journal/catalog caller conformance.
Arbitrary Rust unwind, filesystem internals and unconditional progress. An indefinitely paused holder or legitimate owner may block retirement/reclamation.
performance: Not measured. Gate/registry work has runtime cost; the four-host finite smoke does not certify remote drain or latency bounds.
